title: Introduce General Shell Branding With Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator
description: Introduce a first-class ShellBrand mechanism so framework shell apps can ship as differently-branded standalone builds: brand identity (window title, logo SVG, favicon), locked preference axes, defaulted axes (new SEMIO_DEFAULT_EXAMPLE channel), and a brand-owned introduction. Wire a registry `brand` column on playground rows and use it to add the "Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator" variant — a branded standalone puzzle3d with locked German locale, locked reuse terminology, locked semio theme, switchable appearance, typographic wordmark logo, custom German introduction, and Abbau Aufbau (concrete-forest) as default-but-switchable example — including dev/build configs, package.json scripts, and launch.json entries on port 6023.
